scenes.say: The oldest school in the world that is still open, was founded by a woman.
scenes.cap: The oldest school in the world that is STILL OPEN... was founded by a WOMAN.

scenes.say: Her name was Fatima al-Fihri. She moved to Fez, in Morocco, from Tunisia.
scenes.cap: Her name was FATIMA AL-FIHRI. She moved to Fez, in Morocco, from Tunisia.

scenes.say: When her father died, she inherited a fortune.
scenes.cap: When her father died, she inherited a FORTUNE.

scenes.say: She didn't spend it on herself. She built a mosque, and a place to learn.
scenes.cap: She didn't spend it on herself. She built a MOSQUE, and a place to LEARN.

scenes.say: In eight fifty-nine, al-Qarawiyyin opened its doors.
Scholars came to study the Quran, law, astronomy, mathematics, and medicine.
scenes.cap: Scholars came to study the QURAN, law, ASTRONOMY, mathematics, and MEDICINE.

scenes.say: Its library holds manuscripts more than a thousand years old.
scenes.cap: Its library holds manuscripts more than 1,000 YEARS old.

scenes.say: Guinness World Records calls it the oldest educational institution still running.
scenes.cap: Guinness World Records calls it the OLDEST educational institution still running.

scenes.say: And students still learn there today, more than eleven hundred years later.
scenes.cap: And students still learn there TODAY, more than 1,100 YEARS later.

scenes.say: All because one woman decided to build a school.
scenes.cap: All because ONE WOMAN decided to build a school.

upload.title: The World’s Oldest School Was Founded by a Woman 🕌 #shorts
upload.description:
In 859, Fatima al-Fihri used her inheritance to found al-Qarawiyyin in Fez, Morocco - a mosque and a place of learning. Guinness World Records lists it as the oldest existing, continually operating educational institution in the world.

Read more: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_al-Qarawiyyin
